title: The silent-undo check reads all of a merge's lost lines as branch-own, not the first 25
why: Lane bg-tail-loses-verdict ([ended:Lane:-bg-tail-loses-verdict]), measured 23:05 CST Nov 8 on stack D (#1803 and up): lint/check_silent_undo.py reads at most 25 lines per merge as branch-own (OWN_LOOKUPS). Old merges 24b6c1423 (35 lines of hooks/guard_stream.py) and f1b102825 (45 lines) lose only the lane's own verdict-pipe-exit lines, which branch_only_lines confirms on the full lists, yet the check still reports 10 and 20 lines as undone main work.
note: Bandaid in use: Drops-lines trailers on #1717 and stack D's base. A trailer also excuses any real drop of guard_stream.py later in the same range, so lifting the cap is the real fix. Red case first: a merge that loses 30 branch-own lines of one file. PR #2391, head 3890562bf (23:58 CST Nov 8); two notes in the outbox. Done: #2391 merged in batch 68 (#2449, 8bc28980b, 11:55 CST Nov 9). Its docstring note goes to a docs PR.
